Verdict

Critical exposure

Widest confirmed reach: members of acme-actions

Members of acme-actions can push code that runs in 12 repos across 2 orgs (confirmed), including 1 cloud OIDC trust, 1 secret scope, 1 self-hosted runner pool.

Start here Pin acme-actions/deploy@main to a commit SHA in every workflow that uses it to remove 72% of confirmed reach. All fixes

Confirmed means every hop was read live, ≈ inferred from other observed facts by a documented rule, or read from a recent audit log entry. Possible means at least one hop is ? not visible to the token: unknown, not absent. The two are separate figures and never added up.

Top fixes

Choke points first: each fix removes the most confirmed reach left after the fixes above it.

  1. 1

    Pin acme-actions/deploy@main to a commit SHA in every workflow that uses it

    A branch or tag ref can be moved: whoever can push to acme-actions/deploy changes the code every workflow that uses it runs.

    pin:action:acme-actions/deploy@main

    72% of confirmed reach

    18 confirmed pairs · 72% cumulative

  2. 2

    Lower the default repository permission of acme-actions to read

    Every member of acme-actions inherits write access to its repos by default, so any member account can push code that CI runs.

    default_perm:org:acme-actions->read

    16% of confirmed reach

    4 confirmed pairs · 88% cumulative

  3. 3

    Pin acme-actions/deploy@v1 to a commit SHA in every workflow that uses it

    A branch or tag ref can be moved: whoever can push to acme-actions/deploy changes the code every workflow that uses it runs.

    pin:action:acme-actions/deploy@v1

    4% of confirmed reach

    1 confirmed pair · 92% cumulative

Greedy pick by confirmed (principal, repo) pairs removed; the bar shows the earlier fixes in a lighter shade. Fixes that only touch not visible edges are never suggested.

Repos on the top paths

  • acme-actions/deploy: default branch `main`: protected (ruleset:7), 1 approval, CODEOWNERS review, force push blocked; CODEOWNERS covers workflows; secret scanning on, push protection on
  • acme-actions/setup: default branch `main`: not protected; no CODEOWNERS; secret scanning on, push protection off
  • acme-app/web: default branch `main`: protected (classic), 2 approvals, force push blocked, admins can bypass; CODEOWNERS does not cover workflows; secret scanning on, push protection off

Hardening suggestions

Advisory: these settings are not counted as removing confirmed reach.

  • Require at least one approving review on the default branch of acme-actions/setup (default branch `main` is not protected)
  • Enable secret scanning push protection on acme-actions/setup (secret scanning push protection is off)
  • Enable secret scanning push protection on acme-app/web (secret scanning push protection is off)
